blocks.text: Pancreas mein zyada tar exocrine cells hain jo pancreatic juice bana kar pancreatic duct mein dalte hain. Lekin pancreas mein kuch khaas cells bhi hain jo endocrine gland ka kaam karte hain. Yeh cells pancreas mein chhote chhote dhabbon (patches) ki shakal mein bikhre hote hain, jinhein Islets of Langerhans kehte hain. Har islet do qism ke cells se bana hai: beta (β) cells tadad mein zyada hain aur insulin hormone chhorte hain; alpha (α) cells glucagon hormone chhorte hain.

Insulin jism ke sab se ahem hormones mein se hai. Yeh khoon mein sugar (glucose) ki miqdar kam karta hai, aur tab chhoot'ta hai jab khoon ka glucose barh jaye. Yeh jism ke cells (maslan skeletal muscles aur charbi ke cells) mein glucose ke dakhile ki raftar barhata hai. Yeh jigar mein glycogenesis (glucose ko glycogen banana) barhata hai, cellular respiration mein glucose ka istemal barhata hai, zaid glucose ko charbi (fat) mein badalwata hai aur gluconeogenesis (naya glucose banana) ko rokta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: duodenum ke mor mein pancreas aur oopar gallbladder (pitta); pancreas par aik chhota chaukor neeche bara kar ke dikhaya gaya hai. Neeche: islet of Langerhans, beta cells (hare) ka gol guchha jis mein alpha cells (neele) zyada tar kinare par hain, aur capillaries mein laal khoon ke cells (RBC); is ke gird exocrine hisse ke gol acini hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar pancreas duodenum (chhoti aant ka pehla hissa) ke mor mein dikhaya gaya hai; us par bana chhota chaukor neeche bara kar ke dikhaya gaya hai. Neeche ka gol guchha ek islet of Langerhans hai: is ke andar zyada tadad mein beta cells (insulin) hain aur kinaron ki taraf alpha cells (glucagon). Islet ke gird gol acini exocrine hissa hain jo pancreatic juice banate hain. Beech mein capillaries ke laal RBC dikhate hain ke hormones seedha khoon mein jate hain.

Glucagon khoon ka glucose barhata hai. Yeh tab chhoot'ta hai jab khoon ka glucose normal se kam ho. Yeh khaas taur par jigar mein jama glycogen ki hydrolysis (pani ki madad se torna) karwata hai. Is se glucose khoon mein aata hai, jise cells le kar tawanai (energy) ke liye istemal karte hain.
Pancreas ke hormones ka adam tawazun

items: Insulin kam nikle to diabetes mellitus (hyperglycaemia) hota hai: cells khoon se glucose nahin le pate, is liye khoon ka glucose normal se zyada rehta hai. Yeh zaid glucose gurdon mein pani ke wapas jazb hone ko rokta hai, is liye bohat zyada peshab banta hai. Is se jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration) aur gurdon ko nuqsan hota hai.
Insulin zyada nikle to khoon ka glucose normal se kam ho jata hai: hypoglycaemia. Is ki alamaat: susti, chakkar aana, ghabrahat, aur shadeed surat mein behoshi.

blocks.title: For Information: Type I aur Type II diabetes
blocks.text:
Type I diabetes (insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus) mein mareez ke insulin banane wale β cells nahin hote. Is ka ilaj aam taur par roz insulin ke injections se hota hai; insulin peptide hormone hai, is liye munh se lene par hazam ho jayegi, is liye ise injection se khoon mein dena parta hai. Yeh injection wali insulin genetically engineered bacteria banate hain.
Type II diabetes (non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus) ke mareezon ke khoon mein insulin normal hoti hai magar un ke cells insulin ke liye kam hassas (sensitive) hote hain. Kitab ke mutabiq in mareezon ko insulin ki zaroorat nahin hoti; yeh doosri dawaon, ghiza (diet) aur warzish se diabetes qaboo karte hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke Type II ke mareezon ko insulin ki zaroorat nahin hoti. Bohat se mareez waqai insulin ke baghair qaboo mein rehte hain, magar bimari barhne par Type II ke kuch mareezon ko bhi insulin leni parti hai.

blocks.prompt: Be-qaboo diabetes mellitus mein insan bohat zyada peshab kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Khoon mein zaid glucose gurdon mein pani ke wapas jazb hone ko rokta hai. Is liye zyada pani peshab mein chala jata hai, zyada peshab banta hai aur jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration) ho jati hai.

items: Pancreas zyada tar exocrine hai; Islets of Langerhans endocrine hisse hain: beta (β) cells insulin, alpha (α) cells glucagon.
Insulin glucose kam karta hai (cells mein dakhila, glycogenesis, respiration, charbi; gluconeogenesis band). Glucagon jigar ka glycogen tor kar glucose barhata hai.
Insulin kam: diabetes mellitus (Type I: β cells nahin, injections; Type II: cells kam hassas). Insulin zyada: hypoglycaemia.
